title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.2
subtitle: Quick Assign restored and a fading detach tab.

highlights.title: Quick Assign restored
highlights.description: The floating Add button opens its radial role menu again. Pull to Detach uses an independent operator registration.

highlights.title: Smooth red fade
highlights.description: The hidden detach tab fades from red on the left to transparent beneath the fixed logo.

highlights.title: Clear icons while armed
highlights.description: Logo and folder icons keep their transparency while the release-to-detach caption is visible. Baked playback and cache preservation remain unchanged.
